questions.question: How many orders are in the database?
How many customers are there?
rubric: Counts customers rows, not distinct customers on orders

questions.question: How many products are in the catalog?
How many orders were placed through the web channel?
rubric: Does not confuse channel with customer region

questions.question: How many order line items are there?
What is the average line_total across all order items?
rubric: Does not confuse this with average order value (AOV)

questions.question: Which region had the largest month-over-month order growth (by order count)?
questions.expected_answer: Central region, +6 orders from Dec 2024 to Jan 2025 (largest MoM growth)
rubric: Identifies Central as the top region
Joins orders to customers for region
Computes month-over-month difference in order counts (not revenue)
Reports growth of +6 for the winning month

questions.question: What is the total revenue (sum of line_total) for Apparel products sold through the store channel?
rubric: Joins order_items → products (category) and order_items → orders (channel)
Sums line_total (not unit_price × quantity from products alone)

questions.question: How many orders did Consumer-segment customers place via the web channel?
Which customer segment has the highest average order value (mean of per-order sum of line_total)?
rubric: Computes per-order totals then averages by segment (not AVG(line_total))

questions.question: What is total Electronics revenue?
questions.expected_answer: 157640.18 all-time, with an explicit assumption that no time range was specified (default_time_window / all available dates). Must not silently pick a year; 2024 alone is 63428.38.
rubric: Reports ~157640.18 as the all-time Electronics sum(line_total)
Explicitly discloses the all-available-dates / no-time-range assumption (BR-12)
Joins order_items to products with category='Electronics'
Does not sum products.unit_price alone or invent a year without saying so

questions.question: How are sales performing recently?
questions.expected_answer: Needs clarification: metric (order count vs revenue), definition of 'recently' (time window), and any segment/channel filter.
rubric: Does not invent a metric or time window
Asks a clarifying question (needs_clarification) rather than guessing
Mentions at least one of: metric, time range, segment/channel

questions.question: How many orders were placed in 2024?
What is total revenue across all order items?
What is total Electronics revenue in 2024?
rubric: Joins order_items → products (Electronics) and orders (2024 date filter)

questions.question: How many active customers are there as of 2025-06-21?
rubric: Uses glossary active_customer: at least one order in the trailing 90 days ending 2025-06-21 (orders on/after 2025-03-23)

questions.question: What is the overall average order value?
rubric: Computes mean of per-order SUM(line_total), not AVG(line_total) (glossary AOV)
Does not filter by segment or channel unless asked

questions.question: Which product category has the highest total revenue?
How many orders were placed through the mobile channel?
How many orders came from West-region customers?
How many Home products are in the catalog?
What is the average quantity per order line item?
rubric: Does not confuse with average order value

questions.question: Which sales channel has the most orders?
rubric: Identifies web as the top channel
Ranks above mobile (64), store (36), and partner (26)

questions.question: What is total Sports revenue in 2025?
rubric: Joins order_items → products (Sports) and orders (2025 date filter)

questions.question: How many Enterprise-segment customers are there?
rubric: Counts customers rows, not their orders

questions.question: How many orders have more than one line item?
rubric: Groups order_items by order_id and filters HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
Does not count order_items rows with quantity > 1 as a substitute

questions.question: Which customer_id placed the most orders?
rubric: Uses COUNT on orders grouped by customer_id

questions.question: How many orders did North-region Enterprise customers place?
What is the total revenue for Home products sold through the web channel?
Which sales channel has the highest average order value?
rubric: Computes mean of per-order SUM(line_total) by channel (glossary AOV), not AVG(line_total)
Ranks above mobile (~1641.17), web (~1530.25), and partner (~1120.44)
